status: Layered Highground sniper marker, generated from the user's Glowing Skull reference.

runtime.legacy_style: Original code-built crosshair, center dot and corner brackets; shares placement and health-based pulse.

skull.alignment: Visible alpha > 32 bounds center (126.5, 123) in the 256px texture is aligned to the ring center.

runtime.reduced_motion: Steady at full alpha. No rotation or zoom in any mode.

export: 256x256, 32-bit uncompressed RGBA TGA; source alpha preserved. Neutral layers are vertex-tinted by the addon.

layers.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / game UI asset extraction and reinterpretation.
Input image: the user's "Glowing Skull Emblem Variations" reference sheet. Use the LEFT circular emblem as the design reference.
Recreate the requested component as a clean standalone layer for a 52-pixel World of Warcraft targeting marker. Genuine transparent RGBA background; all empty areas fully transparent. Square canvas, front-on, centered, crisp silhouette, generous transparent edge padding. The layer will be colored at runtime, so use ONLY neutral white, light gray, charcoal and black, with a luminous white main surface and a narrow solid black readability outline. White and gray may have restrained simple shading but no metallic complexity. Keep it clean at tiny sizes.
No colored background, no smoky backdrop, no checkerboard pixels, no text, no panels, no labels, no extra symbols, no detached particles. No large glow haze. This is an individual transparent sprite, not a presentation board.
Extract and reinterpret ONLY the outer circular sight. A thin clean WHITE circular ring with four small compact diamond / spearhead pointers at top, bottom, left and right. Each pointer crosses the ring and points slightly toward the open center, suggesting the reference without its long protruding spikes. Ring outer diameter about 72 percent of canvas, total tip-to-tip span about 84 percent. Ring white stroke approximately 3 percent of canvas width, black edge about 1.5 percent on each side. Each diamond is short and simple, about 10 percent long and 6 percent wide. Restrained ivory-like white edge highlighting, no gold color because the game will tint it gold. The entire interior is empty transparent. ABSOLUTELY NO SKULL and NO central crosshair or center dot; those are separate layers. Keep the circular frame complete and usable on its own.
